Represented illegal contact and ball actions now produce evidence-based NFL calls and correct official consequences through Game. Legal hand fighting, incidental contact and actual exceptions remain controls; borderline or missing facts stay explicit rather than becoming random flags.

- Adds native holding, pass-contact and qualified dangerous-contact/teammate-assistance assessment; passing, touching, grounding, fumble and pre-snap rulings; and represented kick rules.
- Composes possession, spots, downs, scores, carryovers, Try rulings, clock consequences and disqualification. Official statistical credit stays separate from the raw physical ending, using actual possession checkpoints.
- World changes add delivered-contact observations and action descriptors. Physical laws, capacities, defaults and experimental flags are unchanged.

Depends on #178 (`7d475e5efdc81257c2f19efbf468c59cb93e2834`); this PR is based on its branch so that scope remains independently reviewable. Approved develop remains `2c98bed94adad8087c65f381d4090444ad283985`.

[Exact final receipt](https://github.com/tannerthardy/football-simulation-/blob/codex/nfl-contact-rules/data/reviews/current/nfl-contact-rules/final-receipt.json). Protected candidate: `a5af57a2267b8ec5406b8c8cfd9ef40b0abc40c0`. All 44 accepted settings, components enabled. The first failed run is preserved; original physics/RNG hashes remain unchanged. This is substantial rules support, not certification of every NFL action. Referee vision remains deferred. Anatomical actions need achieved receipts; a native successful hip-drop finish remains unproven. Reduced kick/boundary interpretations and remaining statistical/administrative limits are listed in the [scope and evidence](https://github.com/tannerthardy/football-simulation-/blob/codex/nfl-contact-rules/docs/reviews/nfl-contact-rules-2026-10-20.md).
